message.text: The s3presign runner keeps external attachment links from going stale. I am now checking its implementation and the server startup wiring in server.go to find the exact schedule and line numbers.
Found the S3 presign runner. Next I’ll read its schedule and how server startup starts it.

Checking where `startBackgroundRunners` is called to confirm the wiring site for server startup.

The runner is the S3 presign runner, scheduled every 12 hours. It is wired into server startup in `server/server.go` around lines 161–169.

The component is `s3presign.Runner` in `server/runner/s3presign`.

It runs every 12 hours. It is wired into server startup at `server/server.go:129` via `s.startBackgroundRunners`, which creates the runner at line 162.

h01.
s3presign.Runner — every 12 hours — server/server.go:129

The runner in `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go` re-presigns S3 attachment URLs (`CheckAndPresign`) so stored `Reference` links do not expire. `runnerInterval` is `12 * time.Hour`. `Server.Start` wires it in by calling `startBackgroundRunners`, which constructs the runner, runs it once immediately, then starts `Run` on a ticker.
